constraints: PL fabric resources reflect the XC7Z020 (e.g. ZedBoard/PYNQ-Z1 class device); larger Zynq-7000 parts have substantially more capacity.
No native floating-point units in the PL fabric; FP32/FP16 layers must be fully quantized before export to the HDL backend.
Recurrent layers (LSTM/GRU) unsupported in v1 HDL backend.
Dual Cortex-A9 PS is not modeled by this profile; tensor_memory_bytes and fpga_resources describe PL-side inference capacity only.
